skill.name: landing-optimizer
skill.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize our landing page for influencer traffic", "fix our promo-code landing page", or "improve conversion from a creator campaign"; produces a message-match audit, page-structure and social-proof recommendations, a promo-code/CTA conversion plan, and an A/B test roadmap. Not for measuring campaign results after launch — use performance-analyzer.
skill.summary: Optimizes influencer landing pages for message match, trust, CTA flow, promo codes, and test planning.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Influencer traffic often drops when the landing page does not match the creator message. This skill audits message match, trust, CTA flow, promo codes, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Captures campaign context, landing URL, creator message, promo code, current conversion rate, and goal.
Scores message match across message, value proposition, offer, product, and tone.
Recommends landing page structure, creator proof placement, mobile CTA fixes, and promo-code flow.
Builds a prioritized conversion plan with expected impact and effort estimates.
Creates an A/B testing roadmap with hypotheses, variants, duration, sample-size guidance, and success metrics.
Defines tracking targets for UTM parameters, events, conversion rate, bounce rate, add-to-cart, and AOV.
limitations: It does not deploy page changes or edit a CMS by itself.
It relies on user-supplied metrics unless analytics or testing connectors are available.
It does not measure post-launch campaign results; use performance-analyzer for that step.
Estimated conversion lift must be validated with real traffic and controlled tests.

use_cases.title: Improve a Creator Campaign Page
use_cases.description: Audit a low-converting influencer landing page and turn the creator message into page fixes.

use_cases.title: Plan Paid Creator Post-Click Pages
use_cases.description: Check that a paid creator or ad landing page matches offer terms, promo codes, and claims.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Conversion Tests
use_cases.description: Build a practical A/B test roadmap for hero copy, social proof, CTA placement, and promo-code behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Landing Page Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review with basic campaign details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize our landing page for traffic from [creator or campaign]. The page is [URL]. The promo code is [code]. Current conversion rate is [rate].

prompt_templates.title: Message Match Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate audit focused on creator content continuity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this creator message with our landing page: [creator quote or content summary]. Audit message, offer, product, tone, proof, and CTA match.

prompt_templates.title: Promo-Code Conversion Fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of discount flow and mobile friction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find friction in our influencer promo-code experience. Review code visibility, auto-apply behavior, checkout confirmation, mobile CTA placement, and trust signals.

prompt_templates.title: Full Test Roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a structured optimization cycle.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-week A/B testing roadmap for this influencer landing page. Include hypotheses, variants, sample-size guidance, duration, success metrics, and launch priority.

output_examples.input: A fitness creator sends traffic to a protein page with a 1.2% conversion rate and code ANNA20.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies message mismatch, missing creator proof, promo-code friction, and a below-fold mobile CTA. It recommends matching the headline, adding creator video, auto-applying ANNA20, and testing CTA copy.

output_examples.input: A beauty campaign needs a dedicated page for one creator and a limited-time offer.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a creator-specific hero, verified offer wording, prominent expiration details, creator testimonial placement, mobile purchase flow fixes, and UTM event tracking.

output_examples.input: A team wants to test hero copy, social proof order, and promo-code display.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a test sequence with ranked impact, effort, hypotheses, variants, timing, primary metrics, and guardrail metrics.

best_practices: Provide the exact creator message, landing URL, offer terms, promo code, and current conversion metric.
Validate every recommendation with analytics, scroll data, checkout behavior, or controlled A/B testing.
Keep creator proof, offer details, and CTA copy consistent from post to page to checkout.
anti_patterns: Using the same generic landing page for every creator campaign.
Hiding the promo code until checkout or requiring manual copy and paste.
Treating estimated conversion lift as proof before post-launch measurement.

faq.question: Does this skill edit my landing page automatically?
faq.answer: No. It produces an optimization plan, page recommendations, and test roadmap for your team to implement.

faq.question: Can it work without analytics access?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use user-supplied conversion rate, traffic source, creator message, and promo-code details.

faq.question: What makes it different from a general landing page audit?
faq.answer: It focuses on influencer traffic, creator message continuity, social proof hierarchy, promo-code flow, and creator-specific pages.

faq.question: Does it support paid ads landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can also check paid post-click message match and offer consistency when campaign details are provided.

faq.question: What outputs should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a message-match score, prioritized fixes, page-structure guidance, promo-code recommendations, tracking notes, and an A/B test plan.

faq.question: Does it replace post-launch measurement?
faq.answer: No. Use a measurement or performance-analysis workflow after changes launch to confirm conversion impact.
